The model now separates owned-asset value from a finite capital-allocation franchise. The active platform case assumes 25% of existing PDP cash is retained, $50m of externally funded acquisitions per year for ten years, and 15% net NPV created per purchase dollar after financing, tax and dilution. That contributes a formula-driven $2.11/share, lifting active value to roughly $14.08/share. The $26.16 reference price still requires either greater scale, stronger persistent acquisition alpha, more net inventory, better unit economics, or a combination.
